subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Coming back to my earlier email on validated-lead acquisition for your marketplace. A timely shift worth flagging: Vinted traded 10.8 billion euros in gross merchandise value last year, up 47 percent, so two-sided lead demand is fragmenting fast across categories. At that pace the gap between a raw install and a lead that clears your back-end checks is where your real acquisition cost hides. We screen on the acceptance event and measure paid leads against a holdout, so you read clean enquiries rather than a clean-looking line. Worth comparing your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: Vinted 47% GMV growth fragmenting lead demand (sourced) + acceptance-vs-install cost gap
register_notes: Stage 2 EN classifieds: acknowledges continuation + references prior email in first sentence; FRESH angle distinct from stage 1 = timely sourced development (Vinted 10.8bn euro GMV +47% YoY, verified via parent's Vinted financial-results-2025 source) framed against the acceptance-vs-install cost gap for this vertical+market; brand rotated to Vinted from candidate set; no MobUpps figure this stage; market context REAL and sourced with the retained verified URL; soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; native UK English; no em-dash, no curly quotes, no 'X, not Y' comma-negation (rendered positively as 'rather than a clean-looking line').
